task: Add backend batch endpoint POST /v1/admin/project-budgets/member-overrides/bulk with a 4-phase service method (check, write, one rebalance per budget, audit) for bulk member budget overrides (EPMCDME-16071).

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the single-item PATCH override_member_allocation, which does not cover multi-budget orchestration. Novel parts: per-item result model (no multi-status precedent in this router), check-then-write phasing on lightweight copies to avoid AsyncSession autoflush of attached ORM rows, whole-request rollback on a Phase 3 400 via a single router commit, and 403-before-any-write across all distinct budgets (admin authorization). The AC enumerates edge and error cases (404 budget, 404 member, 400 amount, 400 fixed-sum, repeated budget/user, 403) with no existing bulk test template. Per-item flush+refresh in update_member_override plus per-budget rebalance and LiteLLM sync also carry write-amplification and latency considerations.

Modified: rest_api/models/project_budget.py, project_budget_router.py, project_budget_service.py, router_guards baselines openapi.json and route_precedence.json, plus existing router and service tests (about 7-9 modified). New: bulk-specific test files (about 1-2). Spread over rest_api/models, rest_api/routers, service/budget, tests, and the router_guards baselines directory (3+ directories).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk set to L: edge/error cases enumerated in AC with no existing bulk test template, and no exact precedent for per-item result and single-transaction rollback semantics
Affects authorization: whole-request 403 must precede any write across all distinct budgets (reuses _ensure_can_manage_project_budget_members, so no further bump beyond L)
